races.title: Oddschecker Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: COWBOY CASANOVA has shown enough to date to land a race of this nature and appeals as the one to beat. Highbourne Karisma is an interesting French recruit for her connections and appeals as next best, while Mint Approved has to be respected on his bumper form. COWBOY CASANOVA (IRE) HIGHBOURNE KARISMA (FR) MINT APPROVED (FR)

races.title: Oddschecker Mares' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: An open-looking mares' handicap in which it could pay to side with LIMERICK LASS , who acquitted herself well in a handful of starts last season and Anthony Honeyball's 6-y-o should have more to offer now handicapping. Stablemate Queen's Theatre has a similar profile to the selection, so she could be the one to provide most resistance, with returning Dawn Run winner White Noise rounding off the shortlist. LIMERICK LASS (IRE) QUEEN'S THEATRE WHITE NOISE (IRE)
